reason: The $24.99 launch price for a first box is under what I usually pay, and a named lab with the batch report on the page answers my 'is it tested' question. The pre-counted sachet helps because I forget my vitamins on the counter half the time.
objection: It is made in China and sold on TikTok Shop, so I would open the lab report myself to check it is a real lab and the batch number matches before I trust it.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report was missing, unreadable, or did not match the batch number, I would not buy.
